info.description: League service with Google sign-in and server-side sessions.
info.title: League API

get.description: Verifies state and the ID token, upserts the user, issues the sid + csrf cookies, then 302s to the frontend. Called by Google, never by the SPA.

parameters.description: opaque state, must match the oauth_tx cookie
parameters.name: state

parameters.description: set by Google when the user cancels
parameters.name: error

get.description: Sets the sealed oauth_tx cookie and 302s to Google. Open this in the browser, not from Swagger UI's "Try it out" — it is a navigation, not an XHR.

post.description: Deletes the session row and clears the sid + csrf cookies. A user has one session, so this signs them out everywhere.

get.description: The catalog is a fixed vocabulary, returned whole. It is read-only over HTTP: codes are compared by authorization code elsewhere in the backend, so they are added and removed by migration.

post.description: `code` is the authorization contract and cannot be changed afterwards.

delete.description: Cascades: rows in roles_permissions and users_roles go with it, so everyone holding this role loses what it granted. SUPER_ADMIN cannot be deleted.

patch.description: Partial update: an absent field is left unchanged. `code` cannot be changed — create a new role instead.

parameters.description: only teams entered in this division (uuid)
parameters.name: division_id

post.description: `division_id` is required: a team is created in a division. `team_code` is the team code XXyyA (region, host location, team sequence), unique within the division; lower case is accepted and stored upper case. The team then enters a division with POST /teams/{id}/divisions, and the captain is set with PATCH once the player is on the roster.

get.description: Active players only, with their stats in the division (zero before the first match).
get.summary: List a team's roster in a division

404.description: 40401 NOT_FOUND (team has not entered the division)

post.description: A player can be on only one active roster per division, and the team must have entered the division.
post.summary: Add a player to a team's roster in a division

403.description: 40305 PERMISSION_DENIED (not the team captain, or an unpaid member)

404.description: 40401 NOT_FOUND (player, or team has not entered the division)

409.description: 40901 CONFLICT (already on a roster in the division)

delete.description: Closes the roster entry rather than deleting it, so match history keeps the player's team. The team captain cannot be removed.
delete.summary: Remove a player from a team's roster in a division

403.description: 40305 PERMISSION_DENIED (not the team captain, or an unpaid member)

patch.description: Closes the player's roster entry and opens one on `team_id`, in `division_id` or the current division when absent, in one transaction. The team captain cannot be transferred.
patch.summary: Transfer a player to another team

403.description: 40305 PERMISSION_DENIED (not the team captain, or an unpaid member)

404.description: 40401 NOT_FOUND (team, roster entry, or target team has not entered the division)

409.description: 40901 CONFLICT (captain, or already on a roster in the target division)

delete.description: Soft delete: the team is hidden and its active roster entries are closed, freeing its players. Fixtures, division entries, roster history and its team_code are kept until DELETE /teams/{id}/permanent.

patch.description: Partial update: an absent field is left unchanged. `captain_player_id` must be on the team's active roster in some division.

post.description: How a permanent team plays a season: one entry per division.
post.summary: Enter a team into a division

delete.description: Cascades to the team's roster in that division. A team with a fixture in the division cannot be withdrawn.
delete.summary: Withdraw a team from a division

delete.description: Only a team already deleted with DELETE /teams/{id}. Cascades to its division entries and roster history; a team with scheduled or played matches cannot be removed. Cannot be undone.

409.description: 40901 CONFLICT (not deleted yet, or team has matches)

description.example: Runs the leagues they are assigned to.

CSRFToken.description: Echo the value of the `csrf` cookie. Required on every state-changing /api/v1 call.
CSRFToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
